name: US Solar - United States Solar Corporation
old_description: A Sunscription connects you to Community Solar, allowing you to save money, support local clean energy, and have more control over your power, without ever installing panels on your roof.
about:
US Solar, based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, was founded in 2014. The company became part of US Clean Energy, a private holding company focused on distributed power generation, in 2023.

The firm develops, owns, operates, finances, and manages subscriptions for community solar, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and distributed power projects. As of 2026, it has completed over 350 MW of distributed generation, has more than 2 GW active or in development across 14 states, serves 15,000-plus community solar subscribers, and has produced 1 billion kWh of clean energy. The team numbers 90-plus.

Its solutions serve households, businesses, municipalities, landowners, utilities, and large corporations such as Walmart. Notable partnerships include serving as the official solar partner of the Minnesota Twins and supporting Colorado nonprofits like Bridge House with workforce training.

US Solar emphasizes its role as a long-term, independent owner-operator with an end-to-end model that delivers localized energy solutions. The company highlights community benefits including agrivoltaics, pollinator habitat, soil health improvements, and over $1 million committed to community impact initiatives.
